summary.text: Katie Duncan is a candidate with no political party affiliation for the Nevada State Assembly, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Democrat Jovan Jackson.

paragraphs.text: Katie Duncan was born in Ratio, Arkansas, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 1989; Ballotpedia lists her professional experience as working as a historic preservation advocate.
As of 2024, she was affiliated with the Ward 5 Chamber of Commerce, Harrison House, Universal Peace Federation, American Clergy Leadership Conference and the African Diaspora Leadership Conference.
Duncan ran for Nevada State Assembly District 6 in 2020 as a Republican and lost to Democrat Shondra Summers-Armstrong, 80.4% to 19.6%.
In 2024 she was one of eight candidates in the nonpartisan primary for Las Vegas City Council Ward 5, where she received 10.8% of the vote.
